# LeukLogic — full site description for LLMs and answer engines

Last updated: 2026-08-27. Everything below reflects what is published on
https://leuklogic.com and its tool pages; nothing here is aspirational or invented.

## What LeukLogic is

LeukLogic builds small software for businesses: Discord and Slack bots, automations and
scheduled reports, web scrapers, AI triage and routing workflows, internal tools and
dashboards, and fast static websites. It is run by one person — Tim McGirl — and is based in
the United States (Virginia). Contact is by email only: tim@leuklogic.com. There is no form,
no funnel, and no newsletter; replies usually come the same day.

LeukLogic is new. The site carries no client logos, testimonials, or case studies, and says
so plainly rather than inventing them.

## Services and prices

- Discord or Slack bots — FAQ answering, moderation, tickets, onboarding.
- Scheduled data pulls, scrapers, and automated reports.
- AI triage and routing workflows.
- Small web apps, dashboards, and internal tools.
- Fast static websites — static, fast, no plugins to break.

Pricing, as published on the site:

- A bot, an automation, or a scheduled report: $100–$500, delivered in days, not weeks.
- Larger builds (internal tools, dashboards, multi-step workflows, anything with a real
  interface): scoped and quoted at a flat fixed price before anything starts.
- The price is approved by the client before work begins and does not move unless the
  client asks for something new.
- Running costs, if any (hosting, API fees), are the client's and go straight to the
  provider — never marked up through LeukLogic.
- No retainers, no lock-in, no monthly fees. The client keeps the code, the repo, and all
  accounts in their own name.

Things LeukLogic will not take on: teams, SLAs, or 24/7 on-call; mobile apps; six-month
platform rebuilds or abandoned codebases sight unseen; AI bolted onto problems a checklist
would solve; retainers.

## How an engagement works

1. Email the task to tim@leuklogic.com (a hard technical question in the first email is
   welcomed).
2. LeukLogic replies with a fixed price and a delivery date — usually within a day.
3. Work starts with a $100 deposit paid through Stripe (credit and debit cards, Apple Pay,
   Google Pay). The deposit comes off the project price, and checkout requires a project
   reference issued after scope sign-off — a deposit with no agreed project attached just
   gets refunded. An invoice is available on request.
4. LeukLogic builds and delivers; the remainder is due on delivery.

## The eight free tools

All tools at https://leuklogic.com/tools/ are free, require no account or sign-up, and run
entirely in the browser: the data or files you put into them are processed on your own
machine and are not uploaded anywhere.

### QuickQuote — https://leuklogic.com/tools/quote/

Pick what you need — a Discord/Slack bot, web scraper, automation, dashboard, or website —
and get the same fixed-price band LeukLogic would quote by email, in about ten seconds, with
no email address required to see the number. Rates were researched across 2026 direct-client
and marketplace data, a bundle discount of 10% applies, and the locked quote is the price
you pay as long as the scope doesn't change, with two revision rounds included. Hosting runs
on the client's own accounts (typically $0–50/mo) and is never silently billed through
LeukLogic.

### SwiftStatement — https://leuklogic.com/tools/statement-csv/

Drop a bank statement PDF and get clean Date, Description, Amount rows ready for Excel,
Sheets, or bookkeeping software. It runs entirely in the browser — the statement never
leaves your machine — using a locally hosted copy of Mozilla's pdf.js, the same engine
Firefox uses. Lines it can't parse are listed for you to check: never silently dropped,
never guessed into numbers.

### SubScan — https://leuklogic.com/tools/subscription-scanner/

Drop a bank or card statement CSV and instantly see every recurring charge, ranked by what
it costs you per year, with price hikes flagged. It runs entirely in the browser — no
sign-up, no upload, no tracking — and the statement never leaves your machine.

### DeltaCSV — https://leuklogic.com/tools/csv-diff/

Compare two CSVs by a key column you pick, not by line order, so a re-sorted export shows
only what genuinely changed. Files never leave the browser — you can open the browser's
Network tab, reload, load a file, and watch nothing get sent anywhere. No account, no
upload, no tracking.

### FlipCSV — https://leuklogic.com/tools/csv-json/

Paste a spreadsheet export and get clean JSON; paste JSON and get a spreadsheet-ready CSV.
Conversion is lossless by default with strict RFC 4180 quoting, and it runs entirely in the
browser — the data never leaves your machine.

### CronText — https://leuklogic.com/tools/cron/

Paste a cron expression and see exactly what it means in plain English, plus the next times
it will run. The page loads no scripts, fonts, images, or analytics from anywhere and makes
no network request after it loads — expressions never leave your machine.

### Missed-Call Cost Calculator — https://leuklogic.com/tools/missed-call-calculator/

Put in three numbers and see the real annual revenue a service business loses to missed and
unanswered calls — and how much a text-back could recover. Runs entirely in the browser;
nothing typed into it is uploaded or stored.

### CheckClip — https://leuklogic.com/tools/video-check/

Drop a video file and instantly see whether its length, aspect ratio, and file size fit
YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and X — including the throttle rules most spec
tables skip. The video never leaves your machine: no account, no upload, no tracking.

## Technical posture

Every page on leuklogic.com is a single self-contained file: inline CSS and JavaScript,
system font stacks, zero external requests, no cookies, no analytics. The only external
link on the site is the Stripe checkout page for the $100 deposit, which loads nothing
unless clicked. SwiftStatement's PDF engine is vendored on the same origin.
